# simple-webmcp — LLM context
# Title: simple-webmcp — Make JS Functions Agent-Ready | WebMCP SDK
# Description: Function-first WebMCP SDK for JavaScript & React. Turn any function into a Model Context Protocol browser tool — webmcp(fn) stays callable.
# Repository: https://github.com/emingure/simple-webmcp
# Docs: https://emingure.github.io/simple-webmcp/

## Pages
- / — Introduction — Why function-first, one function two interfaces
- /getting-started — Getting Started — Install, vanilla global/manual, React useWebMCP/Scope, Zod, polyfill, hooks
- /guide/schema — Schema & Inference — hierarchy, fields patch, Zod & StandardSchema (merged), whole vs per-field
- /guide/react — React — useWebMCP, Scope, WebMCPProvider
- /guide/hooks — Hooks — before/after/error/denied lifecycle, ordering, HITL
- /guide/analytics/ — Analytics & Observability — Overview, choose provider
- /guide/analytics/step-by-step — Analytics Step-by-Step — 4-step generic setup
- /guide/analytics/posthog — PostHog — step-by-step WebMCP analytics
- /guide/analytics/sentry — Sentry — error + performance via hooks
- /guide/analytics/ga4 — GA4 — gtag events for WebMCP tools
- /guide/inspect — Inspect — listTools, invokeTool, Inspector devtools
- /guide/browser-support — Browser Support & Polyfill — Chrome, Firefox, Safari, @mcp-b polyfill
- /reference/ — Reference — Core webmcp() API (alias /api/)
- /reference/react — Reference — React hooks
- /reference/hooks — Reference — Hook types
- /reference/inspect — Reference — Inspect
- /reference/errors — Reference — Errors & Registry
- /examples/ — Examples — gallery
- /examples/vanilla — Vanilla JS example
- /examples/react — React example
- /examples/zod — Zod example
- /demo — Live Demo — shopping cart + Hooks & HITL log

## External references
- WebMCP imperative API: https://developer.chrome.com/docs/ai/webmcp/imperative-api
- MCP spec: https://modelcontextprotocol.io
- Production polyfill: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mcp-b/webmcp-polyfill
- StandardSchema: https://github.com/standard-schema/standard-schema
- Zod: https://zod.dev
- PostHog docs: https://posthog.com/docs
- Sentry docs: https://docs.sentry.io
- GA4 gtag: https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4

## Usage
Use `webmcp(fn, {description, fields, schema})` to expose functions. See /getting-started for 30-second start.
For integration, read /guide/hooks then /guide/analytics/step-by-step.
